notes:
petmicrochiplookup.org: enter a chip number to find which registry it's in (doesn't store owner data, points you to the right company).

One registry is no longer searched: AAHA's page says Save This Life has ceased operations and was disconnected from the lookup. If your pet's chip was registered there, ask your vet.
